paragraphs: This fictional library example explains how to collect reserved books. Choose a pickup location and wait for a ready notice before travelling.
Uncollected books return to the shelf after 3 days. A ready notice does not extend this deadline.
Reference link for this fictional example: Pickup information
steps: Submit a request with your name and pickup location.
Wait for the library to review the request and send a ready notice.
Bring your library card when collecting the books.
